_published_faq.name: How do I add magnews to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add magnews to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-mn1.mag-news.it/mcp/stream. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the magnews MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: magnews provides these MCP tools: findAudiences, findCommunications, findWorkflows, getCommunicationContent, getCommunicationInsights, getDatabaseFields, getTransactionalMessagesInsights, getWorkflowsInsights, listDatabases, listJourneys, and updateCommunicationAttribute.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to magnews?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to magnews in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
